# BlinkQuest: Vision Ergonomics, MediaPipe Blink Tracking and Eye Strain Prevention

> Production Site: https://blinkquest.devamit.co.in
> AnvayKosh Ecosystem Application: com.amit.blinkquest
> Systems Architect: Amit Chakraborty (https://amitchakraborty.dev)

## Technical Architecture & Core Capabilities
- On-device camera blink rate tracking using MediaPipe Face Mesh in RAM.
- 20-20-20 ergonomic rest timers and eye health assessments.
- Complete local processing with zero cloud data storage.
- All sensitive data processed 100% locally on user hardware.
- Cryptographic isolation backed by device Keystore AES-256 GCM encryption.
- Zero commercial data brokers, zero third-party telemetry SDKs, and zero advertisement networks.
